import ctypes
import os

def gsl_cdf_beta_P(x, a, b):
    """Compute the lower tail CDF of the Beta distribution."""
    return gsl.gsl_cdf_beta_P(x, a, b)

def gsl_cdf_beta_Q(x, a, b):
    """Compute the upper tail CDF of the Beta distribution."""
    return gsl.gsl_cdf_beta_Q(x, a, b)
